tokens.name: lokta
tokens.usage: Page ground. A soft off-white, as on Woodwrights. There is no dark theme and no black ground.

tokens.name: lokta-deep
tokens.usage: Recessed bands: story chapters, the footer, the 3D viewer stage.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces that stand for a physical document: the object label, the catalogue card, the registry record.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: The deepest ground: the home hero and one band per page. Pair with paper (white) and lokta-deep so neighbouring sections never match.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, 1px. Dividers between label rows and input borders. Borders, not shadows.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on lokta, lokta-deep and paper.

tokens.name: stone
tokens.usage: Secondary text and metadata on any ground. Named for Patan's grey basalt.

tokens.name: malachite
tokens.usage: The one action colour, a warm orange (#DA6D42): primary buttons, focus rings, the active chapter, and the highlighted word in a heading. Use it for fills, borders and large type. For small text and links use malachite-ink.

tokens.name: malachite-ink
tokens.usage: The action colour as readable text: links, small labels and hover text on white or paper (5.1 to 1).

tokens.name: malachite-wash
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind a selected option or the impact panel. Text on it is ink or malachite.

tokens.name: on-malachite
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an orange fill. White, as chosen for the brand. Note: white on #DA6D42 is 3.4 to 1, so keep this text at 15px semibold or larger.

tokens.name: gilt
tokens.usage: Fire-gilding gold. Reserved for provenance: the registry seal, the halo rule, the ownership mark. Never a button, never body text on lokta in light (use gilt-ink).

tokens.name: gilt-ink
tokens.usage: Gilt as readable text: registry numbers and the 'Recorded' line on lokta or paper.

tokens.name: lapis
tokens.usage: Place and journey: the map pin, region names, the 'where it was made' chapter. Ground lapis from thangka blues.

tokens.name: sindur
tokens.usage: Signal only: 'one of one', 'last piece', errors. Small, never a block.

families.display: "Hanken Grotesk", "Mukta", "Noto Sans Devanagari", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif
families.text: "Hanken Grotesk", "Mukta", "Noto Sans Devanagari", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif
families.registry: "Hanken Grotesk", "Mukta", "Noto Sans Devanagari", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif
families.system: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Piece name on the piece page hero. One per page.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Artisan names, card titles at large size, Devanagari headings.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Cast in copper by the lost-wax method in Patan, then fire-gilded over four days.
styles.usage: The first paragraph of a story. Two to three sentences.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Raju's family has worked wax in Nagbahal for five generations.
styles.usage: Running text, max 64 characters a line.

styles.name: body-s
styles.sample: Dust weekly with a dry, soft brush.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field names on object labels and forms. Set in capitals.

styles.name: registry
styles.usage: Registry numbers, prices, dimensions, dates. Anything a buyer might copy or check.

styles.name: registry-s
styles.usage: Small data on cards and 3D hotspot labels.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inline gaps, icon to text.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Label row padding, minimum side gutter.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a chapter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between chapters on a story page.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between page acts: piece, maker, place, record.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: The default. Labels, cards, images, buttons: square, like a gallery label.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Inputs and chips, just enough to soften on screen.

tokens.name: radius-halo
tokens.usage: Only the registry seal and the artisan portrait halo. The circle means 'recorded'.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Default. Sīpa separates with hairlines and ground changes.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Only the catalogue card when shown as a physical object.

motion.usage: Hover and colour changes take 0.3s, fades 0.5s, both ease. Nothing moves for longer.
